A better lawn starts close to home

More lawn to love. Fewer weeds to fight. Our local team combines seasonal nutrition and weed control in a year-round plan built around your grass, your property, and South Louisiana’s growing conditions.
Clear program. Personal service.

A small centipede lawn in St. Amant and a sunny Bermuda yard in Prairieville should not be treated as identical. We consider your lawn’s size, grass type, and current condition when putting your service plan together.

Thanks for reaching out to Grow Green. Our team will review your property details and contact you about your lawn fertilization and weed control estimate. This is a quote request, not a scheduled treatment.
The Grow Green approach
A stronger lawn takes more than a quick color boost. Our program brings nutrition, weed management, and regular attention together throughout the year.

Liquid fertilization is adjusted for your grass and its stage of growth. Nutrients, iron, and other micronutrients are selected when appropriate—not added simply because another visit is on the calendar.
Seasonally timed pre-emergents help reduce new weed pressure. Targeted post-emergents address existing weeds using products suited to your turf and the application conditions.
Regular visits let us monitor lawn response and seasonal insect or disease concerns. We explain any issue that needs closer attention and whether additional care falls outside your program.
We treat lawns; we do not mow them. Your mowing and watering habits still matter. We’ll share aftercare directions so everyday maintenance supports your treatment plan.
Eight visits. Different seasonal jobs.
Our year-round program follows the growing season—not a one-size-fits-all fertilizer mix. Here is the big-picture rhythm.
Time nutrition to active growth, manage early weeds, and plan preventive applications around seasonal weed pressure.
Adjust nutrition and weed control for grass type, heat, rain, and lawn response while watching for seasonal pest issues.
Reduce growth-pushing nitrogen as warm-season turf slows. Focus on season-appropriate nutrition and cool-season weed prevention.
Monitor lawn conditions and address winter weed pressure. Dormant warm-season grass does not need summer-style nitrogen feeding.
This is a seasonal overview, not a guaranteed application calendar. Actual products, rates, and timing depend on turf needs, weather, and label directions.
Know the grass under your feet
Ascension lawns are not all the same. A healthy target for one grass type can mean too much growth for another. We build the plan around the turf you actually have.
Helpful homeowner reading: LSU AgCenter’s Louisiana Lawn Maintenance guide (PDF) and UF/IFAS guidance on centipedegrass .
Ascension isn’t just a service area
Grow Green is a local, firefighter-owned business based in St. Amant. When you reach out, you’re talking with a team that serves the same communities we call home.
We focus on lawn treatments, clear communication, and care that makes sense for South Louisiana turf. Your address is more than another stop on a national franchise’s map.
Not sure if your address is on our route? Send it through the estimate form and we’ll confirm service availability.
Good questions. Clear answers.
A few things Ascension homeowners often want to know before starting a lawn program.

Our lawn fertilization and weed control program includes seasonal planned visits per year, generally about six weeks apart. Timing can shift with weather and turf conditions. Each visit has a seasonal purpose; it is not the same fertilizer application repeated eight times.

The annual program price is spread across twelve monthly payments for predictable billing. Monthly billing does not mean monthly treatments. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract; your estimate explains the price and terms before you approve.

Yes. The lawn program combines seasonally timed pre-emergent weed prevention with targeted post-emergent control for existing weeds. Products and timing depend on grass type, weed activity, weather, and the label. Some persistent weeds need continued management, and complete permanent elimination is not guaranteed.

No. Shade, drainage, mowing, pests, disease, and soil conditions can also affect your lawn. Tell us what you are seeing so we can consider the cause. A soil test may help guide nutrient or pH decisions. Fertilizer cannot revive dead grass or correct a drainage problem by itself.

Yes. You can request an estimate at any time. We will review your lawn and recommend an appropriate starting point based on the season and its condition, rather than trying to apply missed visits all at once.

Usually not, as long as we have the access needed for your scheduled service. Please unlock gates, secure pets, and tell us about access restrictions or sensitive areas. Follow the service notes and any watering or mowing instructions provided after treatment.

Keep people and pets away from the treatment area during application. Follow the specific re-entry and aftercare instructions provided for the products used. Do not assume that one waiting period applies to every treatment.
We serve homeowners in St. Amant, Prairieville, Gonzales, Dutchtown, Geismar, Sorrento, and Galvez. Send your service address so our team can confirm coverage and prepare pricing for your property.

    Our year-round program follows the growing season—not a one-size-fits-all fertilizer mix. Here is the big-picture rhythm.

    1. Spring / wake up

      Support the green-up.

      Time nutrition to active growth, manage early weeds, and plan preventive applications around seasonal weed pressure.

    2. Summer / grow steadily

      Feed with conditions in mind.

      Adjust nutrition and weed control for grass type, heat, rain, and lawn response while watching for seasonal pest issues.

    3. Fall / transition

      Shift the focus.

      Reduce growth-pushing nitrogen as warm-season turf slows. Focus on season-appropriate nutrition and cool-season weed prevention.

    4. Winter / keep watch

      Manage weeds, respect dormancy.

      Monitor lawn conditions and address winter weed pressure. Dormant warm-season grass does not need summer-style nitrogen feeding.

    This is a seasonal overview, not a guaranteed application calendar. Actual products, rates, and timing depend on turf needs, weather, and label directions.

    Know the grass under your feet

    Different grass.
    Different needs.

    Ascension lawns are not all the same. A healthy target for one grass type can mean too much growth for another. We build the plan around the turf you actually have.

    Yellow grass is a clue—not a diagnosis.Soil conditions, shade, mowing, excess moisture, insects, and disease can all play a role. More fertilizer is not automatically the answer.
    How turf type shapes the approach
    CentipedeA lower-nitrogen grass with a naturally lighter color. Chasing an unnaturally dark green with extra fertilizer can work against its health.
    St. AugustineNutrition needs to reflect sunlight, growth, and stress. A shaded area should not automatically receive the same inputs as a sunny one.
    BermudaGenerally has higher nitrogen needs than centipede. The right plan still depends on its growing conditions and how the lawn is maintained.
    ZoysiaMeasured feeding helps balance growth with maintenance. Extra nitrogen is not a shortcut to solving thatch or underlying soil problems.

    Good questions. Clear answers.

    Before we get growing.

    A few things Ascension homeowners often want to know before starting a lawn program.

    Ask our team a question
    How many lawn treatments are included each year?

    Our lawn fertilization and weed control program includes seasonal planned visits per year, generally about six weeks apart. Timing can shift with weather and turf conditions. Each visit has a seasonal purpose; it is not the same fertilizer application repeated eight times.

    Why are there twelve monthly payments but eight visits?

    The annual program price is spread across twelve monthly payments for predictable billing. Monthly billing does not mean monthly treatments. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract; your estimate explains the price and terms before you approve.

    Is weed control included with fertilization?

    Yes. The lawn program combines seasonally timed pre-emergent weed prevention with targeted post-emergent control for existing weeds. Products and timing depend on grass type, weed activity, weather, and the label. Some persistent weeds need continued management, and complete permanent elimination is not guaranteed.

    Does yellow or thin grass always need more fertilizer?

    No. Shade, drainage, mowing, pests, disease, and soil conditions can also affect your lawn. Tell us what you are seeing so we can consider the cause. A soil test may help guide nutrient or pH decisions. Fertilizer cannot revive dead grass or correct a drainage problem by itself.

    Can I start the program partway through the year?

    Yes. You can request an estimate at any time. We will review your lawn and recommend an appropriate starting point based on the season and its condition, rather than trying to apply missed visits all at once.

    Do I need to be home for treatment?

    Usually not, as long as we have the access needed for your scheduled service. Please unlock gates, secure pets, and tell us about access restrictions or sensitive areas. Follow the service notes and any watering or mowing instructions provided after treatment.

    When can children and pets use the lawn again?

    Keep people and pets away from the treatment area during application. Follow the specific re-entry and aftercare instructions provided for the products used. Do not assume that one waiting period applies to every treatment.

    Which Ascension Parish communities do you serve?

    We serve homeowners in St. Amant, Prairieville, Gonzales, Dutchtown, Geismar, Sorrento, and Galvez. Send your service address so our team can confirm coverage and prepare pricing for your property.

real_faqs.q: When can children and pets use the lawn again?
real_faqs.a: Keep people and pets away from the treatment area during application. Follow the specific re-entry and aftercare instructions provided for the products used. Do not assume that one waiting period applies to every treatment.

real_faqs.q: Which Ascension Parish communities do you serve?
real_faqs.a: We serve homeowners in St. Amant, Prairieville, Gonzales, Dutchtown, Geismar, Sorrento, and Galvez. Send your service address so our team can confirm coverage and prepare pricing for your property.
